description: Utility functions for managing and converting filter tags, including creation, formatting, conversion to API format, parsing input, and URL serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: generateFilterId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID for filters.

methods.name: createFilterTag
methods.description: Creates a filter tag object with specified type, value, and optional custom label.

methods.name: formatFilterLabel
methods.description: Formats a label string for a filter tag based on its type and value.

methods.name: convertTagsToApiFormat
methods.description: Converts an array of filter tags into API request format with filters and grouping.

methods.name: convertApiFormatToTags
methods.description: Converts API filters and grouping back into filter tags.

methods.name: parseFilterInput
methods.description: Parses a string input into an array of filter tags.

methods.name: serializeFiltersToUrl
methods.description: Serializes filter tags into URL query string format.

methods.name: deserializeFiltersFromUrl
methods.description: Deserializes URL query parameters into filter tags.
